result: No actionable P0 or P1 defect observed in this bounded image review; two camera evidence gaps remain.

provenance.reported_by_parent: All 26 files are ordinary UI free exports/downloads from actual runtime models. Camera poses were set through developer debug controls.
provenance.independently_verified: Inspected all 26 actual PNGs at original 1280x656 resolution; independently rehashed downloaded files against both receipts and rehashed all 57 exact source reference files. Reopened seven reference comparison boards for the low-view comparisons.
provenance.source_model_identity_binding: Uses the existing exact candidate/model-SHA manifest and parent runtime provenance; PNG pixels alone do not cryptographically prove GLB identity.

historical_supersession.earlier_download_event_timeout: The earlier timeout remains a historical observation. It is superseded as an unresolved download blocker for these 26 exports by actual downloaded files matching the preview receipt hashes and sizes.
historical_supersession.scope_limit: These are 19 close and seven low views, not a documented close-and-occluded pair for every candidate.

close_scan.checks: No new blank/black render, missing target, obvious wrong variant, generic replacement prism, gross stretching, severe geometry loss, or continuous floating base observed. Architectural clay simplification and lighting do not imply keeper approval.

unresolved_finite_evidence.next_capture: Orbit to the gable side and capture a low oblique including the timber framing, glazing, entrance relationship and grade. This is an evidence gap, not a demonstrated missing-gable defect.
Capture a low oblique at about 30-45 degrees from this yaw so the blade sign face and entrance are visible together. This is an evidence gap, not a demonstrated missing-sign defect.

close_scan.observation: Paired duplex massing, bay division and entries remain visible.
Plateau duplex identity and external stair remain visible.
Courtyard massing and arches remain visible.
Barrel-vault market structure and flanking galleries remain visible.

low_view_followup.observation: Open front, central aisle, repeated iron arches and flanking galleries are visible. Front floor meets the ground without an obvious continuous gap. The whole portal is not blocked.
low_view_followup.remaining_scope_or_next_capture: Does not establish every stall, internal traversal, or every rear contact.

close_scan.observation: Aquatic arched enclosure and internal structure remain visible.
Full tiered tower and crown fit in the close frame.

low_view_followup.observation: Ground-floor glazing and dark piers are visible and meet the grass plane without an obvious continuous gap. The base/entrance visibility gap is resolved.
low_view_followup.remaining_scope_or_next_capture: The upper tower is deliberately cropped in this base view; crown detail is outside this entrance/contact follow-up.

close_scan.observation: Timber building silhouette, roof and facade remain recognizable.
Villa roof and facade identity remain recognizable.
Cinema massing, marquee and stepped front remain visible; blade face is edge-on.

low_view_followup.observation: Ground doors below the marquee, marquee front and base are now visible without an obvious gap. The projecting vertical blade sign remains edge-on.
low_view_followup.remaining_scope_or_next_capture: Capture a low oblique at about 30-45 degrees from this yaw so the blade sign face and entrance are visible together. This is an evidence gap, not a demonstrated missing-sign defect.

close_scan.observation: Green roof and curved clerestories remain visible; timber gable is outside the viewed elevation.

low_view_followup.observation: Recessed entrance, interior shelving through glazing and flush ground contact are visible on the dark long elevation. The source-defining timber-truss glazed gable is still hidden around the side.
low_view_followup.remaining_scope_or_next_capture: Orbit to the gable side and capture a low oblique including the timber framing, glazing, entrance relationship and grade. This is an evidence gap, not a demonstrated missing-gable defect.

close_scan.observation: Cafe roof, courtyard and awning remain visible.
Station front hall and tower identity remain visible.
School roof and facade profile remain recognizable.
Hotel roof and stepped building profile remain recognizable.
Grocery sign and front glazing remain visible.
Hall roof and post arrangement remain visible; low view supplies entrance/clerestory detail.

low_view_followup.observation: Clerestory band below the roof, slender dark posts seated on the apron and the small lobby wing are visible. No obvious detached post or floating apron is visible.
low_view_followup.remaining_scope_or_next_capture: Does not establish all rear elevations or interior access.

close_scan.observation: Cabin roof and porch remain visible; low view supplies facade detail.

low_view_followup.observation: Log courses, central door, paired windows, porch posts, porch base and central steps are visible. Posts and steps appear seated without an obvious gap.
low_view_followup.remaining_scope_or_next_capture: Does not establish walking collisions or every hidden support.

close_scan.observation: Shop strip roof and bay rhythm remain visible; low view supplies signage and entrances.

low_view_followup.observation: Four labelled shop bays and their door/window groups are visible: PRAIRIE DELI, HARDWARE SUPPLY, LIQUOR STORE, GIFTS & MORE. Bases appear at grade without obvious floating or burying.
low_view_followup.remaining_scope_or_next_capture: No land-use or operator approval is inferred from the storefront labels.

close_scan.observation: Corner merchant facade and balcony remain visible.
